data.body: Baseline re-run 2026-11-22 12:21 PST inside the Claude Code Bash sandbox (allowed_domains api.anthropic.com), cli-main at 39d78c81fd5: _build_retrying_anthropic_provider(base_url='https://api.anthropic.com', cfg=LLMConfig()) with the default wrapped transport -> APIConnectionError <- gaierror [Errno 8] nodename nor servname provided. Same call with _wrapped_transport=httpx.AsyncHTTPTransport(proxy=HTTPS_PROXY) -> completion returned. Survey of src/rebar: only the 3 LLM sites build an explicit transport (Anthropic httpx, Anthropic httpx2, OpenAI-compatible); MCP introspection (transport=None default), Jira DC (requests), review-bot and terraform probe (urllib openers), Bedrock (boto3) already honour the proxy environment, so nothing to file. Plan refined in the description; file_impact set. Working in worktree bluewhale-llm-proxy from 39d78c81fd5.
